reason: The cited lines describe a read-only web search tool returning ranked results, snippets, and optionally extracted page content from open-web sources such as websites, GitHub/issues/docs, PDFs, news/images, and research-affiliated sites. The lines do not show arbitrary host code execution, access to host files/private databases/credentialed SaaS/localhost/intranet content, or delivery of agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable destination; searches appear query-only and any vendor search request is not itself a SINK under the provided definition.
